hotels.title: Award-Winning Daintree Rainforest Eco Retreat with Daily Breakfast & A$100 Dining Credit
hotels.description: Escape to the heart of the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Daintree Rainforest - the oldest tropical rainforest on Earth - where nature and thoughtful hospitality exist in perfect harmony. 15 treehouse-style Bayans are tucked among the ancient canopy, each a private haven immersed in the sights, sounds and earthy scents of the rainforest. At Julaymba Restaurant and Bar, meals are served against a breathtaking rainforest backdrop, with menus built around organic produce from the surrounding region. Spend your days cooling off at the lodge's swimming pool or natural waterhole, soak in an outdoor bath overlooking the treetops, surrender to treatments at Daintree Wellness Spa, and reconnect with yoga classes. Join a guided rainforest walk, pack a picnic hamper in search of hidden waterfalls, or connect with the land through Indigenous cultural activities. There is simply nowhere else on Earth quite like it - a place where two UNESCO World Heritage Sites meet, where ancient rainforest tumbles down to the Great Barrier Reef.

hotels.title: Boutique Cape Tribulation Retreat near the Great Barrier Reef & Daintree Rainforest
hotels.description: Experience the magical place where the Great Barrier Reef meets the Daintree Rainforest - the only place in the world where two UNESCO World Heritage-listed sites come together - at the boutique Mist at Cape Tribulation. Succumb to the beauty of this unique destination, nestled in Queensland's pristine tropics, less than a three-hour drive from Cairns and just a 30-metre stroll from the world's oldest rainforest. Sleep in a luxe self-contained pavilion with a fully equipped kitchenette, surrounded by rare palm trees, resident sunbirds and magnificent views, and enjoy easy access to the onsite Turtle Rock Café, a relaxed destination for fresh, wholesome food. Unwind and reconnect with nature among the jungle canopy and freshwater creek, stop in the small orchard, where, when in season, tropical fruits are free to pick, settle on the decking and watch the fireflies play, or sink into one of the property's double hammocks and listen out for the calls of the lesser sooty owl. Make the most of the nature on your doorstep with a range of incredible activities: snorkel through the colourful, underwater paradise of the Great Barrier Reef, arrange a guided walk through the rainforest, or ride along the endless stretch of sand on an unforgettable horseback adventure (surcharges apply).
